blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Bioenergetics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Pehle flowchart wali activity, phir har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah (kitab MCQs ki key nahi deti); short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
From the given flowchart, build a paragraph that can describe a comparison between photosynthesis and respiration in terms of reactants and products of major steps.
[The printed flowchart: a chloroplast (left) in which sunlight falls on PS-II and PS-I; NADP and ADP go to the photosystems and NADPH and ATP come out to the Calvin cycle; CO₂ enters the Calvin cycle, which gives glucose. Glucose gives pyruvic acid (with ATP), which enters the Krebs cycle in a mitochondrion (right); the Krebs cycle gives ATP and CO₂ (arrow back to the Calvin cycle) and NADH; NAD and NADH link it to the electron transport chain, which gives ATP and heat. O₂ passes from the photosystems to the electron transport chain, and H₂O from the electron transport chain back to the photosystems.]
Diye gaye flowchart se aik paragraph banayein jo major steps ke reactants aur products ke lehaz se photosynthesis aur respiration ka muqabla kare.
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis aur respiration aik doosre ke ulat magar jure hue processes hain: aik ke products doosre ke reactants hain. Photosynthesis chloroplast mein hoti hai. Light-dependent reactions mein PS-II aur PS-I sooraj ki roshni jazb karte hain; pani toot-ta hai aur oxygen nikalti hai, aur NADP aur ADP badal kar NADPH aur ATP bante hain. Calvin cycle (light-independent reactions) mein yahi ATP aur NADPH istemal kar ke carbon dioxide ko reduce kar ke glucose banti hai; NADP aur ADP wapas photosystems ko jate hain. Respiration wahan se shuru hoti hai jahan photosynthesis khatam hoti hai: glycolysis mein glucose toot kar pyruvic acid banti hai aur thora ATP milta hai. Pyruvic acid mitochondrion mein ja kar Krebs cycle mein poori tarah oxidize hoti hai; carbon dioxide (jo Calvin cycle phir istemal kar sakta hai), kuch ATP aur NADH bante hain. Electron transport chain mein NADH apne electrons oxygen ko deta hai jo pani banati hai; zyada tar ATP yahin banta hai aur kuch energy garmi ban kar nikal jati hai. Yun photosynthesis CO₂, H₂O aur roshni ki energy le kar glucose aur O₂ banati hai (energy pakarne wala, reduction process), jabke respiration glucose aur O₂ le kar CO₂, H₂O aur ATP ki shakal mein energy deti hai (energy nikalne wala, oxidation process).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Flowchart ko aik gol chakkar samjhein: chloroplast ki O₂ aur glucose mitochondrion mein jati hain, aur mitochondrion ki CO₂ aur H₂O wapas chloroplast mein. Energy roshni se aa kar aakhir mein ATP aur garmi ban jati hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt: 1- What main process occurs during the dark reaction of photosynthesis?
blocks.explanation: Dark (light-independent) reactions mein CO₂ ko reduce kar ke sugar banti hai: Calvin cycle mein NADPH ki hydrogen aur ATP ki energy CO₂ ko di jati hai. Oxygen nikalna, roshni jazb karna aur ATP banna light-dependent reactions mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 2- What is TRUE about glycolysis?

options.text: It takes place only in aerobic respiration
It takes place in the mitochondrion
It reduces 2 molecules of NAD+ for every glucose molecule processed

blocks.explanation: Glycolysis mein dono G3P molecules apne do do hydrogen atoms NAD⁺ ko dete hain, yaani har glucose par 2NAD⁺ → 2NADH. Glycolysis ATP banata hai (net 2), aerobic aur anaerobic dono mein hota hai, aur cytosol mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 3- Which of the following are produced by the reactions that occur in the thylakoid and consumed by the reactions that occur in the stroma?
blocks.explanation: Thylakoid membranes par light-dependent reactions ATP aur NADPH banati hain; stroma mein Calvin cycle inhein CO₂ ko sugar banane mein istemal karta hai. NADP⁺ aur ADP ulti taraf jate hain.

blocks.prompt: 4- When deprived of oxygen, yeast cells obtain energy by fermentation, producing CO2, ATP and;
blocks.explanation: Yeast alcoholic fermentation karta hai: pyruvic acid ethyl alcohol (C₂H₅OH) aur CO₂ mein badalta hai. Lactic acid fermentation (CO₂ ke baghair) muscle cells mein hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: 5- Conversion of Glucose 6-phosphate into Fructose 6-phosphate is;
blocks.explanation: Glycolysis ke doosre step mein glucose 6-phosphate apne isomer fructose 6-phosphate mein badalta hai (formula wahi, tarteeb alag); yeh isomerase enzyme karta hai.

blocks.prompt: 6- In which of the following conversions, ATP is produced?

options.text: Alpha ketoglutaric acid into succinyl CoA

blocks.explanation: Succinic acid aur CoA ka bond high-energy hota hai; succinyl-CoA jab CoA aur succinic acid mein toot-ta hai to nikalne wali energy se aik ATP banta hai. Baqi steps NADH ya FADH₂ dete hain ya pani jorte hain.

blocks.prompt: 7- In electron transport chain, FADH:H produces how many ATPs?
blocks.explanation: FADH₂ apne electrons seedha coenzyme Q ko deta hai, pehle ATP wale step ke baad, is liye is ki oxidation se do ATP bante hain (NADH se teen).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "FADH:H" chhapa hai; sahi FADH₂ hai. Sawal: electron transport chain mein FADH₂ kitne ATP banata hai?

blocks.prompt: 8- Which of these is CO₂ acceptor during photosynthesis?
blocks.explanation: Carbon fixation mein Rubisco CO₂ ko paanch carbon wali sugar ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) se jorta hai aur 3-phosphoglyceric acid banta hai. (C-4 paudon mein pehla acceptor phosphoenol pyruvic acid hai jo options mein nahi.)

blocks.prompt: 9- Which of the following takes the electrons lost by Photosystem I on absorption of light energy?
blocks.explanation: P700 ke excited electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor se ferredoxin (Fd) tak jate hain, jo NADP reductase ke zariye NADP⁺ ko dete hain. Plastocyanin to PS-II se electrons PS-I tak lata hai.

blocks.prompt: 10- Photosystem-II makes up the electrons lost due to light excitation by taking up the electrons released from,
blocks.explanation: PS-II ke P680 ka electron "hole" pani ke electrons se bharta hai: pani toot kar 2H⁺, aik oxygen atom aur 2 electrons deta hai (photolysis).

blocks.prompt:
1- Differentiate between action spectrum and absorption spectrum.
Action spectrum aur absorption spectrum mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Absorption spectrum batata hai pigment kitni roshni jazb karta hai; action spectrum batata hai har wavelength photosynthesis mein kitni kaar-amad hai. Dono milte julte hain.

rows: Mukhtalif wavelengths par photosynthesis ke rate ka graph
Pigment ki jazb ki hui mukhtalif wavelengths ka graph
Har rang ki roshni mein paude ki nikali hui oxygen se napa jata hai
Nikale hue pigment ki jazb ki hui roshni se napa jata hai
Har wavelength ki photosynthesis ke liye kaar-kardagi
Har pigment kaun si wavelengths jazb karta hai
Pehli baar T. W. Engelmann (1883) ne Spirogyra par banaya
Chlorophylls 430 nm (neeli) aur 670 nm (laal) sab se zyada jazb karte hain

blocks.prompt:
2- How is photosynthesis a redox reaction?
Photosynthesis redox reaction kaise hai?
blocks.explanation:
6CO₂ + 12H₂O + light → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O
Pani oxidize hota hai: electrons aur hydrogen ions kho kar oxygen deta hai. CO₂ reduce hoti hai: is mein electrons aur hydrogen ions jur kar sugar banti hai. Oxidation aur reduction saath saath hoti hain, is liye photosynthesis redox process hai.

blocks.prompt:
3- Which molecule contributes Oxygen in glucose? Water or carbon dioxide!
Glucose mein oxygen kaun sa molecule deta hai? Pani ya carbon dioxide?
blocks.explanation: Carbon dioxide. ¹⁸O tajrube mein jin paudon ko H₂¹⁸O diya gaya unhon ne ¹⁸O₂ nikali, aur jinhein C¹⁸O₂ di gayi unhon ne aam O₂. Yaani nikalne wali O₂ pani se aati hai, aur glucose mein jaane wali oxygen CO₂ se.

blocks.prompt:
4- State the role of CO₂ in photosynthesis.
Photosynthesis mein CO₂ ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: CO₂ sugar banane ke liye carbon ka zariya hai. Yeh stomata se patte mein dakhil ho kar mesophyll cell walls ke pani mein ghulti hai; Calvin cycle mein Rubisco ise RuBP se jorta hai aur ATP aur NADPH se yeh reduce ho kar sugar banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5- Define electron transport chain.
Electron transport chain ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation: Electron transport chain electron carriers ka silsila hai (mitochondrion ki andaruni membrane ya thylakoid membrane mein) jo redox reactions se electrons aage se aage dete hain; respiration mein yeh NADH aur FADH₂ se oxygen tak jate hain aur pani banta hai. Nikalne wali energy se chemiosmosis ke zariye ATP banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6- What do you mean by glycolysis?
Glycolysis se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation: Glycolysis aik glucose molecule (6C) ka cytosol mein enzymes ke silsilewar steps se do pyruvic acid (3C) molecules mein tootna hai. Is mein oxygen nahi chahiye, yeh aerobic aur anaerobic dono respiration mein hota hai, aur net 2 ATP aur 2 NADH deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7- What is the main structural difference between chlorophyll-a and chlorophyll-b?
Chlorophyll-a aur chlorophyll-b mein bunyadi structural farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono ka porphyrin head (Mg atom ke gird chaar pyrrole rings) aur lambi hydrocarbon tail hoti hai. Farq doosre pyrrole ring par hai: chlorophyll-a mein methyl group (CH₃), chlorophyll-b mein usi jagah aldehyde group (CHO).

blocks.prompt:
8- How can a cell synthesize ATP through substrate-level phosphorylation?
Cell substrate-level phosphorylation se ATP kaise banata hai?
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme aik organic substrate molecule se phosphate group seedha ADP ko de deta hai, ATP aur naya organic molecule bante hain; koi membrane ya electron transport chain shamil nahi.
Misal: glycolysis ke aakhri step mein phosphoenol pyruvic acid + ADP → pyruvic acid + ATP.

blocks.prompt:
9- Can pyruvic acid enter Krebs cycle as such? If not, what changes are made to it before Krebs cycle?
Kya pyruvic acid seedha Krebs cycle mein ja sakta hai? Agar nahi to Krebs cycle se pehle is mein kya tabdeeliyan hoti hain?
blocks.explanation:
Nahi. Pyruvic acid oxidation mein (mitochondrion ke andar):
1. CO₂ nikalti hai aur acetaldehyde banta hai.
2. Acetaldehyde oxidize ho kar acetyl group banta hai; NAD⁺ reduce ho kar NADH.
3. Acetyl group coenzyme A se jur kar acetyl-CoA banata hai jo Krebs cycle mein jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
10- Differentiate between C-3 and C-4 photosynthesis.
C-3 aur C-4 photosynthesis mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: C-3 paude CO₂ sirf Calvin cycle se pakarte hain; C-4 paude pehle ise chaar carbon wale acid mein pakar kar phir Calvin cycle chalate hain, jis se photorespiration kam hoti hai.

Pehla product 4 carbon wala oxaloacetic acid
CO₂ acceptor: RuBP (Rubisco ke zariye)
Pehla CO₂ acceptor: mesophyll cells mein phosphoenol pyruvic acid (3C)

Photorespiration zyada; garam ilaqon mein 25-50% pakra hua carbon zaya

Energy kam lagti hai
Har glucose par taqreeban dugni energy (zaid ATP)
Misal: zyada tar paude (gandum, chawal)
Misal: makai, ganna, jowar

blocks.prompt:
1- What are photosynthetic pigments and what role they play in the absorption and conversion of light energy?
Photosynthetic pigments kya hain aur roshni ki energy jazb karne aur badalne mein un ka kya kirdar hai?
blocks.explanation:
Photosynthetic pigments chloroplast ki thylakoid membranes mein rangeen molecules hain jo photosynthesis ke liye roshni ki energy pakarte hain: chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, carotenoids (carotenes aur xanthophylls) aur laal algae aur cyanobacteria mein phycobilins.
Roshni jazb karna:
- Roshni chhote zarron (photons) ki dhaar ki tarah hai; pigment molecule aik waqt mein aik photon jazb karta hai.
- Mukhtalif pigments mukhtalif wavelengths jazb karte hain. Chlorophylls zyada tar banafshi-neeli aur narangi-laal roshni (peaks 430 nm aur 670 nm) jazb karte aur sabz wapas pherte hain; carotenoids neeli-sabz hisse mein jazb karte hain.
- Accessory (madadgar) pigments (chlorophyll b, carotenoids, phycobilins) roshni ki range barhate aur apni energy chlorophyll a ko dete hain. Carotenoids zyada roshni se photosynthesis ke nizaam ko nuqsan se bhi bachate hain.
Roshni ki energy ko badalna:
- Pigment photon jazb kare to us ke electrons oonchi energy level par chale jate hain aur woh excited ho jata hai.
- Photosystem mein antenna pigments yeh energy reaction centre ke chlorophyll a (P680 ya P700) ko dete hain.
- Reaction centre high-energy electrons primary electron acceptor ko aur phir electron transport chain mein aage deta hai.
- In ki energy se ATP (chemiosmosis se photophosphorylation) aur NADPH bante hain; P680 ke khoye electrons pani se pure hote hain aur O₂ nikalti hai.
- ATP aur NADPH Calvin cycle mein energy ko sugar ke C-H bonds mein mehfooz karte hain. Yun roshni ki energy chemical energy ban jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
2- How are the absorption spectra of chlorophyll 'a' and 'b' different?
Chlorophyll 'a' aur 'b' ke absorption spectra kaise mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono chlorophylls zyada tar banafshi-neeli aur narangi-laal roshni jazb karte hain aur sabz sab se kam (sabz wapas pherte hain), magar un ki peaks thori mukhtalif wavelengths par hain. Jo wavelengths chlorophyll a jazb nahi karta, chlorophyll b unhein achhi tarah jazb karta hai aur ulat bhi, is se jazb hone wali roshni ki range barh jati hai.

rows: Asal pigment; reaction centres (P680, P700) mein

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Graph mein dono curves ki do do chotiyan (peaks) hoti hain, aik neeli aur aik laal roshni par; beech mein (sabz hissa) curves neeche hoti hain. Chlorophyll b ki chotiyan andar ki taraf (aik doosre ke qareeb) khiski hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
3- Describe and illustrate how photosynthetic pigments are organized in thylakoid membrane?
Bayan karein aur khaake se wazeh karein ke photosynthetic pigments thylakoid membrane mein kaise tarteeb diye gaye hain.
blocks.explanation:
Roshni ko achhi tarah jazb aur istemal karne ke liye photosynthetic pigments guchhon (clusters) mein tarteeb diye gaye hain jinhein photosystems kehte hain; yeh grana ki thylakoid membranes mein dhanse hote hain. Har photosystem mein pigments aur electron transport chain ke carriers hote hain aur is ke do hisse hain:
1. Antenna complex (roshni jama karne wala): bohat se pigment molecules (chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b, carotenoids) proteins se jure; yeh roshni pakar kar energy aik molecule se doosre ko dete hue reaction centre tak pohanchate hain.
2. Reaction centre: aik ya zyada khaas chlorophyll a molecules jo high-energy electrons primary electron acceptor ko dete hain, aur woh unhein electron transport chain ko de deta hai.
Do photosystems (daryaft ki tarteeb se naam):
- Photosystem I (PS-I): reaction centre P700, 700 nm ki roshni behtareen jazb karta hai.
- Photosystem II (PS-II): reaction centre P680, 680 nm ki roshni behtareen jazb karta hai.
Khaka (Fig. 5.7): thylakoid membrane ka hissa banayein (do mutawazi lakeerein, oopar stroma, neeche lumen). Is ke andar aik bara oval photosystem: bohat se chhote sabz nuqte (pigment molecules) antenna complex; un par roshni (photons) ke teer; zig-zag teer pigment se pigment hote hue beech ke chlorophyll a jore tak, label "reaction centre (P680/P700)"; wahan se electron (e⁻) ka teer "primary electron acceptor" ke dabbe tak aur phir electron transport chain tak. Membrane mein PS-II aur PS-I ko saath saath banayein, PQ, cytochrome complex aur PC carriers se jure hue.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Antenna complex ko dish antenna ya keep (funnel) samjhein: bohat se pigments roshni ikatthi kar ke beech wale reaction centre mein dalte hain, jaise keep mein daala pani neeche aik soorakh se nikalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
4- Describe how the role of water in photosynthesis can be explained through experiment.
Bayan karein ke photosynthesis mein pani ka kirdar tajrube se kaise wazeh kiya ja sakta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Pani ka kirdar: pani CO₂ ko reduce karne ke liye hydrogen ka zariya hai, aur photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai.
Mafrooza (hypothesis): 1930s mein Van Niel ne un photosynthetic bacteria par kaam kiya jo CO₂ se carbohydrate banate hain magar oxygen nahi nikalte; us ne kaha ke paude hydrogen ke liye pani torte hain aur oxygen zimni (by-product) ke taur par nikalti hai.
Tajruba (1940s, isotope tracer ¹⁸O):
1. Scientists ne bhari oxygen wala pani (H₂¹⁸O) aur bhari oxygen wali carbon dioxide (C¹⁸O₂) tayyar ki.
2. Group 1 ke paudon ko H₂¹⁸O aur aam CO₂ (C¹⁶O₂) di gayi.
3. Group 2 ke paudon ko C¹⁸O₂ aur aam pani (H₂¹⁶O) diya gaya.
4. Dono ne photosynthesis ki aur un ki nikali hui oxygen jama kar ke test ki gayi.
Nateeja: group 1 ne ¹⁸O₂ nikali; group 2 ne aam oxygen (¹⁶O₂).
Nateeja (conclusion): photosynthesis mein nikalne wali oxygen pani se aati hai, CO₂ se nahi. Pani toot-ta hai (photolysis); is ki hydrogen NADP ko NADPH banati hai jo CO₂ ko sugar mein reduce karne ki taqat (reducing power) hai. Is se Van Niel ki baat sabit hui; yun pani hawa ki oxygen ka bara zariya hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: ¹⁸O oxygen ka bhari isotope hai; yeh aam oxygen ki tarah hi react karti hai magar machine se pehchani ja sakti hai. Is liye ise "nishaan" (tracer) bana kar dekha gaya ke nikalne wali oxygen kis molecule se aayi.

blocks.prompt:
5- What are the events that capture light and convert it into chemical energy during light dependent reactions?
Light dependent reactions mein kaun se waqiat roshni pakar kar use chemical energy mein badalte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Aham waqiat: pigments ka roshni jazb karna, electrons ka excite hona, aur ATP aur NADPH ka banna. Aam taur par yeh non-cyclic photophosphorylation se hota hai jis mein dono photosystems hissa lete hain:
1. PS-II ka roshni jazb karna: roshni antenna chlorophylls ki energy barhati hai; energy P680 tak pohanchti hai jis ke do excited electrons PS-II ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain. P680 mein electron "hole" (khala) reh jata hai aur woh taqatwar oxidizing agent ban jata hai.
2. Photolysis (roshni se pani ka tootna): pani 2H⁺, aik oxygen atom (do mil kar O₂) aur 2 electrons mein toot-ta hai; yeh electrons P680 ka hole bharte hain.
3. PS-II se PS-I tak electrons ka bahao: electrons plastoquinone (PQ), cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin (PC) ki electron transport chain se guzarte hain. Un ki energy qadam ba qadam kam hoti hai aur chemiosmosis se ATP banane mein lagti hai.
4. PS-I ka roshni jazb karna: P700 excite hota hai; is ke electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain aur PS-II se aane wale electrons P700 ka hole bharte hain.
5. PS-I se NADP⁺ tak bahao: electrons ferredoxin (Fd) ko jate hain; NADP reductase enzyme unhein NADP⁺ ko deta hai jo aik H⁺ ke saath reduce ho kar NADPH ban jata hai.
Chemiosmosis: electrons ki energy H⁺ ko stroma se lumen mein pump karti hai; H⁺ ATP synthase se wapas behte hain aur woh ADP aur Pi jor kar ATP banata hai (photophosphorylation).
Pani se PS-II aur PS-I hote hue NADP⁺ tak electrons ka zig-zag raasta Z-scheme kehlata hai. Products: Calvin cycle ke liye ATP (assimilatory power) aur NADPH (reducing power), aur zimni product O₂. Yun roshni ki energy chemical energy ban jati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Z-scheme ko seedhi aur slide samjhein: roshni (PS-II) electron ko oopar uthati hai, woh carriers ki slide se neeche aata hai (ATP banta hai), phir roshni (PS-I) use dobara oopar uthati hai aur woh NADP⁺ tak pohanch kar NADPH banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6- Illustrate the cyclic photophosphorylation.
Cyclic photophosphorylation ko khaake se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Cyclic photophosphorylation: kuch halaat mein PS-I ke excited electrons aik mutabadil gol (cyclic) raasta lete hain. Sirf PS-I istemal hota hai, PS-II nahi.
Steps:
1. Roshni PS-I ke P700 ko excite karti hai; is ke high-energy electrons PS-I ke primary electron acceptor ko jate hain.
2. Electrons ferredoxin (Fd) tak jate hain magar NADP⁺ ki bajaye electron transport chain (cytochrome complex aur plastocyanin) se ghoom kar wapas P700 par aa jate hain.
3. Chain se neeche aate hue un ki energy H⁺ ko lumen mein pump karti hai aur chemiosmosis se ATP banta hai.
Nateeja: ATP banta hai; NADPH nahi banta aur oxygen nahi nikalti (pani nahi toot-ta).
Kab: jab Calvin cycle dheema ho jaye aur chloroplast mein NADPH jama ho jaye; zaid ATP Calvin cycle ki NADPH se zyada ATP ki zaroorat poori karta hai.
Khaka (Fig. 5.10): neeche baen taraf P700 wala PS-I aur us par roshni ke teer; e⁻ ka oopar jata teer energy scale par ooncha "primary electron acceptor" tak; wahan se "Fd" tak teer, phir neeche aata teer "cytochrome complex" (yahan "ATP" likhein) aur "PC" se hote hue wapas P700 tak, yun teer band daira banate hain. Label: "NADPH nahi, O₂ nahi".

blocks.prompt:
7- Describe light independent reactions of photosynthesis in terms of paragraph and illustrate in terms of Calvin cycle.
Photosynthesis ki light independent reactions ko paragraph ki shakal mein bayan karein aur Calvin cycle ke khaake se wazeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Paragraph: Light-independent (dark) reactions chloroplast ke stroma mein reactions ka silsila hain jo CO₂ se carbon, ATP se energy aur NADPH se hydrogen (dono light reactions mein bane) le kar energy se bharpoor sugar banati hain. ATP aur NADPH maujood hon to yeh roshni ya andhere dono mein ho sakti hain. In ki tafseel Melvin Calvin aur saathiyon ne maloom ki (Nobel Prize 1961), is liye inhein Calvin cycle kehte hain; pehla product teen carbon wala hai, is liye C-3 pathway bhi kehte hain. Is ke teen phases hain:
1. Carbon fixation (carbon pakarna): Rubisco (ribulose biphosphate carboxylase, shayad duniya ka sab se zyada paya jane wala protein) 3 CO₂ ko paanch carbon wali ribulose biphosphate (RuBP) ke 3 molecules se jorta hai aur 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ke 6 molecules bante hain.
2. Reduction: 6 ATP phosphate groups jor kar 3-PGA ko 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid banate hain; phir 6 NADPH ise reduce kar ke 6 glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) banate hain aur phosphates hat jate hain. Aik G3P cycle se bahar nikalta hai; do G3P mil kar glucose aur doosre carbohydrates banate hain.
3. RuBP ki dobara tayyari (regeneration): baqi 5 G3P tarteeb badal kar 3 ribulose phosphate (RuP) bante hain; 3 ATP har aik par phosphate jorte hain aur 3 RuBP ban kar phir CO₂ lete hain.
Yani 3 CO₂ pakarne par 9 ATP aur 6 NADPH lagte hain aur 1 G3P milta hai; aik glucose ke liye 6 CO₂ (18 ATP, 12 NADPH).
Khaka (Fig. 5.12): aik bara daira aur us par ghari ki simt mein teen teer. Oopar "3 CO₂ dakhil" aur "Rubisco"; saath "3 RuBP (5C)" jur kar "6 3-PGA (3C)" (phase 1: carbon fixation). Daen taraf neeche: "6 ATP → 6 ADP" aur "6 NADPH → 6 NADP⁺" se "6 G3P" (phase 2: reduction); daire se bahar teer "1 G3P → glucose aur doosre carbohydrates". Baen taraf oopar: "5 G3P" aur "3 ATP → 3 ADP" se wapas "3 RuBP" (phase 3: regeneration).

blocks.prompt:
8- What happens with glucose in anaerobic respiration and how different organisms modify the end products?
Anaerobic respiration mein glucose ke saath kya hota hai aur mukhtalif jandar end products ko kaise badalte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) oxygen ke baghair bohat se microorganisms, bare paudon ke kuch cells aur vertebrates ke muscle cells mein hoti hai. Glucose poori tarah oxidize nahi hota:
1. Glycolysis: cytosol mein glucose 2 pyruvic acid (C₃H₄O₃) mein toot-ta hai, net 2 ATP aur 2 NADH milte hain.
2. Phir pyruvic acid NADH se reduce hota hai (is se NAD⁺ wapas milta hai aur glycolysis chalta rehta hai) aur aise end products bante hain jin mein ab bhi kafi energy hoti hai.
Mukhtalif jandaron mein end products alag hain:
- Alcoholic fermentation: yeast aur kuch bacteria mein pyruvic acid ethyl alcohol (C₂H₅OH) aur CO₂ mein badalta hai: 2C₃H₄O₃ → 2C₂H₅OH + 2CO₂.
- Lactic acid fermentation: insanon aur janwaron ke muscle cells mein (sakht mehnat mein jab oxygen kafi tezi se na pohanche) aur bohat se bacteria mein pyruvic acid lactic acid (C₃H₆O₃) banta hai, CO₂ nahi nikalti.
Energy: har glucose par sirf 2 ATP (glucose ki energy ka taqreeban 2%; 14.6 kcal), aerobic ke 36 ATP se bohat kam.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Rozmarra misalein: roti/naan ka aata yeast ki CO₂ se phoolta hai (alcoholic fermentation); dahi lactic acid bacteria se banta hai; tez daurne ke baad tangon mein thakan lactic acid ki wajah se hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
9- How is glucose broken down to pyruvic acid in glycolysis?
Glycolysis mein glucose pyruvic acid mein kaise toot-ta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Glycolysis cytosol mein hota hai; har step aik khaas enzyme karwata hai, aur ATP aur NAD⁺ zaroori hain. Is ke do phases hain.
Preparatory phase (energy kharch hoti hai aur glucose toot-ta hai):
1. ATP ka phosphate glucose ko milta hai → glucose 6-phosphate.
2. Glucose 6-phosphate apne isomer mein badalta hai → fructose 6-phosphate.
3. Doosra ATP aik aur phosphate jorta hai → fructose 1,6-biphosphate.
4. Fructose 1,6-biphosphate do 3 carbon molecules mein toot-ta hai, glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DAP); yeh aapas mein badal kar 2 G3P bante hain.
Oxidative phase (har G3P ke liye, yaani sab kuch do baar):
5. G3P oxidize hota hai: 2 hydrogen atoms NAD⁺ ko (→ NADH) aur aik inorganic phosphate juta hai → 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (1,3-BPGA).
6. 1,3-BPGA ka phosphate ADP ko → ATP + 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA).
7. 3-PGA → 2-phosphoglyceric acid (2-PGA).
8. 2-PGA se pani nikalta hai → phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP).
9. PEP apna phosphate ADP ko deta hai → ATP + pyruvic acid.
Har glucose ka hisaab: 2 ATP kharch, 4 ATP bane (substrate-level phosphorylation se) = net 2 ATP; 2 NADH; 2 pyruvic acid.
Glucose + 2ADP + 2Pi + 2NAD⁺ → 2 pyruvic acid + 2ATP + 2NADH + 2H⁺

blocks.prompt:
10- Describe how Krebs cycle is the completion of the oxidation of glycolytic products.
Bayan karein ke Krebs cycle glycolysis ke products ki oxidation kaise mukammal karta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Glycolysis glucose ko sirf jazwi (partly) oxidize karta hai: is ke products, 2 pyruvic acid, mein ab bhi zyada tar energy hoti hai. Mitochondrion mein yeh poori tarah CO₂ tak oxidize hote hain.
Pyruvic acid oxidation (link step, har pyruvic acid par): CO₂ nikalti hai (→ acetaldehyde); oxidation se acetyl group aur NADH; acetyl group coenzyme A se jur kar → acetyl-CoA.
Krebs (citric acid) cycle, Sir Hans Krebs ne maloom kiya, mitochondrion mein:
1. Acetyl group (2C) + oxaloacetic acid (4C) → citric acid (6C); CoA alag.
2. Citric acid se CO₂ nikalti (decarboxylation) aur oxidation (NAD⁺ → NADH) → alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5C).
3. Alpha-ketoglutaric acid ki phir oxidation aur decarboxylation (CO₂, NADH) → succinic acid (4C), jo CoA se jur kar → succinyl-CoA.
4. Succinyl-CoA CoA aur succinic acid mein toot-ta hai; is high-energy bond ki energy se 1 ATP.
5. Succinic acid oxidize ho kar fumaric acid; hydrogens FAD ko → FADH₂ banati hain.
6. Fumaric acid mein pani juta hai → malic acid.
7. Malic acid oxidize (NAD⁺ → NADH) → oxaloacetic acid, jo agle acetyl-CoA ke liye tayyar.
Oxidation kaise mukammal hoti hai: har glucose (do chakkar) ke 6 carbons sab CO₂ ban kar nikal jate hain (2 pyruvic acid oxidation mein, 4 Krebs cycle mein), aur saari hydrogen aur electrons coenzymes le lete hain: 8 NADH aur 2 FADH₂ (aur glycolysis ke 2 NADH) aur 2 ATP. Yeh reduced coenzymes apne electrons electron transport chain ko dete hain jahan zyada tar ATP banta hai aur oxygen electrons le kar pani banati hai.

blocks.prompt:
11- Explain the passage of electron through electron transport chain.
Electron transport chain mein electrons ke guzarne ko samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Respiration ki electron transport chain mitochondrion ki andaruni membrane mein bani hoti hai. Electrons glycolysis aur Krebs cycle mein bane reduced coenzymes NADH aur FADH₂ se aate hain.
Electrons ka raasta (Fig. 5.18):
1. NADH oxidize hota hai (→ NAD⁺) aur is ke electrons coenzyme Q (CoQ) le leta hai. FADH₂ oxidize hota hai (→ FAD) aur is ke electrons bhi CoQ ko jate hain.
2. Reduced CoQ electrons cytochrome b ko deta hai.
3. Cytochrome b unhein cytochrome c ko deta hai.
4. Cytochrome c unhein cytochrome a complex (cytochromes a aur a₃) ko deta hai.
5. Yeh complex unhein chain ke aakhir mein oxygen ke atom ko deta hai; oxygen do electrons aur do H⁺ le kar pani banati hai: ½O₂ + 2H⁺ + 2e⁻ → H₂O.
Redox: har carrier electrons le kar reduce aur aage de kar oxidize hota hai. Har qadam par electrons energy khote hain.
Energy ka istemal: nikalne wali energy H⁺ ko matrix se inter-membrane space mein pump karti hai; H⁺ ATP synthase se wapas behte hain aur ATP banta hai (chemiosmosis). Aik NADH se 3 ATP; aik FADH₂ se 2 ATP. Oxygen aakhri electron acceptor hai; is ke baghair chain ruk jati hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chain ko seerhiyon (stairs) ki tarah samjhein: electron oopar (NADH) se qadam ba qadam neeche (oxygen) utarta hai; har qadam par jo energy chhooti hai us se H⁺ pump hote hain, aur unhi se ATP banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12- Define chemiosmosis. How would you relate it with electron transport chain?
Chemiosmosis ki tareef karein. Ise electron transport chain se kaise jorenge?
blocks.explanation:
Chemiosmosis woh tareeqa hai jis mein membranes H⁺ ions ke farq (gradient) ke zariye electron transport chain ki redox reactions ko ATP banane se jorti hain.
Electron transport chain se talluq:
1. ETC mein electrons aik carrier se doosre tak (redox reactions) jate hue energy khote hain.
2. Yeh energy H⁺ ko membrane ke paar active transport karne mein lagti hai: mitochondria mein matrix se inter-membrane space mein; chloroplast mein stroma se thylakoid lumen mein.
3. H⁺ aik taraf jama ho jate hain; H⁺ gradient mein potential energy (jama shuda energy) hoti hai.
4. H⁺ apne gradient ke saath membrane ke khaas protein, ATP synthase enzyme, se wapas behte hain.
5. H⁺ ka yeh bahao ATP synthase ko chalata hai jo ADP aur Pi jor kar ATP banata hai.
Yani ETC H⁺ gradient banati hai aur chemiosmosis use ATP banane mein istemal karta hai; ETC ke baghair gradient nahi aur ATP nahi. Yahi tareeqa mitochondria (oxidative phosphorylation) aur chloroplast (photophosphorylation) dono mein ATP banata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: dam (bund). ETC pani (H⁺) ko pump kar ke dam ke peeche jama karti hai; jab pani turbine (ATP synthase) se neeche girta hai to bijli (ATP) banti hai.

blocks.prompt:
13- Through which ways proteins and fats enter cellular respiration?
Proteins aur fats kin raston se cellular respiration mein dakhil hote hain?
blocks.explanation:
Proteins:
- Pehle digest (hydrolysis) ho kar amino acids bante hain; cell zyada tar amino acids apne proteins banane mein lagata hai.
- Zaid amino acids ka de-amination hota hai (amino group hata diya jata hai).
- Baqi carbon wale hisse pyruvic acid, acetyl-CoA ya Krebs cycle ke organic acids mein badal jate hain aur un ki energy ATP banti hai.
Fats (lipids):
- Bohat se C-H bonds ki wajah se behtareen fuel hain.
- Pehle hydrolysis se glycerol aur fatty acids bante hain.
- Glycerol glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) ban kar glycolysis mein dakhil hota hai.
- Fatty acids acetyl-CoA ban kar Krebs cycle mein jate hain.
Yun proteins aur fats glycolysis, pyruvic acid, acetyl-CoA ya Krebs cycle par respiration mein dakhil ho kar glucose ki tarah oxidize hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
14- Define photorespiration and present it in proving that "photosynthesis is not perfect".
Photorespiration ki tareef karein aur ise is baat ke saboot mein pesh karein ke "photosynthesis mukammal nahi".
blocks.explanation:
Photorespiration: roshni mein sabz cells ki aisi respiratory sargarmi jo O₂ istemal aur CO₂ kharij karti hai (aerobic respiration ki tarah) magar koi ATP nahi banati.
Tareeqa: jab patte ke cells mein CO₂ kam aur O₂ zyada ho to Rubisco RuBP mein CO₂ ki bajaye O₂ jor deta hai. RuBP aik phosphoglycerate aur aik phosphoglycolate (2C) mein toot-ta hai. Phosphoglycolate → glycolate, jo peroxisome mein ja kar O₂ se glyoxylate banta hai (zehreela H₂O₂ bhi banta hai). Glyoxylate → glycine, jo mitochondrion mein jata hai; do glycine mil kar aik serine banate hain aur CO₂ nikalti hai. Serine wapas peroxisome mein → glycerate, jo chloroplast mein phosphoglycerate ban kar Calvin cycle mein wapas jata hai.
Is se kaise sabit hota hai ke photosynthesis mukammal nahi:
1. Aham enzyme Rubisco makhsoos nahi: CO₂ aur O₂ usi active site ke liye muqabla karte hain, is liye RuBP oxygen par zaya hota hai.
2. Pakra hua carbon CO₂ ban kar zaya: C-3 paude apna 25-50% fixed carbon kho dete hain, paidawar kam hoti hai.
3. Energy (products ko wapas lane mein ATP aur NADPH) kharch hoti hai magar na ATP banta hai na sugar.
4. Zehreela hydrogen peroxide banta hai.
5. Zyada garmi mein (garam ilaqon mein 28 °C se oopar) barh jati hai, jab Rubisco ki oxidative sargarmi carbon pakarne se zyada barhti hai.
6. Irtiqa (evolution) ki baqiyat: Rubisco tab bana jab hawa mein O₂ kam thi; O₂ jama hui to muqabla shuru hua.
Paudon ko yeh nuqsan kam karne ke liye naye raste (C-4 photosynthesis, CAM) banane pare, jo dikhata hai ke bunyadi C-3 nizaam mukammal nahi.

blocks.prompt:
15- What are the effects of temperature on the oxidative activity of Rubisco?
Rubisco ki oxidative activity par temperature ke kya asraat hain?
blocks.explanation:
Rubisco ke do kaam hain: carboxylase (RuBP mein CO₂ jorna, carbon fixation) aur oxygenase (RuBP mein O₂ jorna, photorespiration).
Temperature ke asraat:
1. Temperature barhne par Rubisco ki oxidative (oxygenase) sargarmi carbon pakarne ki sargarmi se zyada barhti hai, is liye photorespiration ka rate barhta hai.
2. Garam ilaqon mein, khaas taur par jahan temperature aksar 28 °C se zyada ho, photorespiration sangeen masla ban kar fasalon ki paidawar ko bohat nuqsan deti hai.
3. Zyada fixed carbon zaya hota hai: C-3 paude apna 25-50% (garam ilaqon mein aadhe se zyada) carbon kho sakte hain.
4. (Chapter se aage) Garam khushk mausam mein pani bachane ke liye stomata band hote hain, patte mein CO₂ kam aur photosynthesis ki O₂ zyada ho jati hai; zyada temperature par CO₂ O₂ ke muqable mein kam ghulti hai. Dono oxygenase reaction ko barhate hain.
5. Kam temperature par carboxylase sargarmi ghalib rehti hai aur photorespiration kam hoti hai.
Isi liye C-4 aur CAM paude, jo Rubisco ke gird CO₂ jama karte hain, garam ilaqon mein aam hain.

blocks.prompt:
16- How is the process of C4 photosynthesis an adaptation to deal with the problem of photorespiration?
C4 photosynthesis photorespiration ke masle se nimatne ke liye kaise aik adaptation hai?
blocks.explanation:
Masla: garam ilaqon mein jab patte mein CO₂ kam aur O₂ zyada ho jaye to Rubisco CO₂ ki bajaye O₂ pakarta hai aur C-3 paude photorespiration se bohat sa carbon kho dete hain.
C-4 photosynthesis (ghaas jaise makai, ganna, jowar aur taqreeban do darjan doosre groups) Rubisco ke gird CO₂ jama kar ke yeh masla hal karta hai:
1. Patte ki banawat: mesophyll cells mein hawa ki jagahein kam; Calvin cycle ke enzymes zyada tar bundle-sheath cells mein jo CO₂ ko bahar nahi jane dete.
2. Mesophyll cells mein CO₂ phosphoenol pyruvic acid (3C) se jur kar oxaloacetic acid (4C) banati hai, yahi pehla product (is liye C-4). Yahan ka enzyme O₂ nahi pakarta.
3. Oxaloacetic acid (NADH se) malic acid banta hai aur saath wale bundle-sheath cell mein jata hai.
4. Bundle-sheath cell mein malic acid toot kar pyruvic acid aur CO₂ deta hai. Yeh cells CO₂ rok lete hain, is liye CO₂ ki miqdaar barh jati hai.
5. Zyada CO₂ mein Rubisco photorespiration ki bajaye Calvin cycle (C-3) chalata hai.
6. Pyruvic acid wapas mesophyll cell mein ja kar ATP se dobara phosphoenol pyruvic acid ban jata hai.
Yun C-4 paude C-4 aur C-3 dono raste alag alag cells mein chalate hain. Har glucose par taqreeban dugni energy lagti hai, magar garam ilaqon mein jahan photorespiration aadhe se zyada carbon zaya karti, yeh behtareen samjhota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Mesophyll cell ko "CO₂ pump" samjhein: yeh CO₂ ko malic acid ke packet mein band kar ke bundle-sheath cell tak pohanchata hai; wahan packet khulta hai aur CO₂ itni zyada ho jati hai ke Rubisco ko O₂ pakarne ka moqa hi nahi milta.

blocks.prompt:
1. Why does cellular respiration release energy more efficiently than fermentation?
Cellular respiration fermentation ke muqable mein energy zyada kaar-kardagi se kyun nikalti hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Mukammal aur namukammal oxidation: aerobic respiration glucose ko poori tarah CO₂ aur H₂O tak oxidize kar ke us ke saare C-H bonds ki energy nikalti hai; fermentation glycolysis ke baad ruk jati hai aur zyada tar energy ethanol ya lactic acid mein band reh jati hai.
2. NADH ka istemal: aerobic mein NADH aur FADH₂ electrons ko electron transport chain se oxygen tak le ja kar chemiosmosis se zyada tar ATP banate hain (har NADH se 3, har FADH₂ se 2); fermentation mein NADH sirf pyruvic acid ko reduce karta hai, koi ATP nahi banta.
3. Oxygen aakhri electron acceptor hone ki wajah se Krebs cycle aur electron transport chain chal sakte hain.
4. Hasil: aerobic respiration har glucose se 36 ATP, fermentation sirf 2 ATP (glucose ki energy ka taqreeban 2%), yaani aerobic 18 guna zyada kaar-amad hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Why is the conversion of glucose into ATP during cellular respiration considered a more efficient use of energy than burning glucose directly?
Cellular respiration mein glucose ko ATP mein badalna glucose ko seedha jalane se energy ka behtar istemal kyun samjha jata hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Glucose ko jalane se us ki saari energy aik dum garmi aur roshni ban kar nikalti hai. Cell is energy ko kaam ke liye pakar nahi sakta, aur itni achanak garmi cell ko tabah kar degi.
2. Respiration mein glucose qadam ba qadam oxidize hota hai, har qadam aik khaas enzyme jism ke temperature (37 °C) par control karta hai, is liye energy thori thori nikalti hai.
3. Har qadam par energy ka bara hissa pakar liya jata hai: NADH aur FADH₂ mein, phir electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis se ATP mein (har glucose se 36 ATP; ATP ka har bond taqreeban 7.3 kcal fi mole deta hai). Sirf kuch hissa garmi ban kar zaya hota hai.
4. ATP qabil-e-istemal energy ki currency hai: energy wahan tak le jata hai jahan kaam chahiye (contraction, active transport, synthesis) aur thori thori deta hai.
(Chapter se aage: glucose ki mukammal oxidation taqreeban 686 kcal fi mole deti hai; 36 × 7.3 = 263 kcal ATP mein jama hoti hai, taqreeban 38%, jo car engine ke taqreeban 25% se zyada hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: aik bara note (glucose) dukaan par nahi chalta; use chhote sikkon (ATP) mein tor liya jaye to har chhoti cheez khareedi ja sakti hai. Jalana note ko aag lagane jaisa hai: qeemat (energy) zaya.

blocks.prompt:
3. Why might a disruption in either photosynthesis or respiration processes affect global carbon and oxygen cycles?
Photosynthesis ya respiration mein kisi bigar se dunya ke carbon aur oxygen cycles kyun mutasir ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Photosynthesis aur respiration carbon aur oxygen cycles ke do hisse hain: aik ke products doosre ke reactants hain.
- Photosynthesis hawa aur pani se CO₂ nikalti aur O₂ (pani se) kharij karti hai: 6CO₂ + 12H₂O → C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ + 6H₂O. Photolysis ki oxygen hawa ki oxygen ka bara zariya hai.
- Tamaam jandaron ki respiration O₂ istemal kar ke CO₂ wapas hawa mein deti hai: C₆H₁₂O₆ + 6O₂ → 6CO₂ + 6H₂O + energy.
- Aam taur par dono mein tawazun rehta hai aur hawa mein CO₂ aur O₂ ki miqdaar taqreeban mustaqil rehti hai.
Agar photosynthesis bigre (jangalon ki katai, samandaron aur jheelon ki aaloodgi, jahan zyada tar photosynthesis hoti hai) to kam CO₂ nikalti aur kam O₂ banti hai: CO₂ jama hoti hai (chapter se aage: global warming barhti hai) aur aerobic jandaron ke liye oxygen kam hoti hai; food chains ki energy ki bunyad bhi kamzor hoti hai.
Agar respiration bigre (maslan decomposers kam hon) to CO₂ ki wapsi dheemi, murda organic maadda jama aur carbon band ho jata hai; phir paudon ko photosynthesis ke liye kam CO₂ milti hai.
Is liye koi bhi adam-tawazun poori dunya ki hawa, pani aur jandaron mein carbon aur oxygen ki miqdaar badal deta hai.
